units.source_text: 古歌：“春夜何妨暗，寒梅处处开。

en.t: An old poem says: What harm is there if a spring night is dark? Cold plum blossoms are blooming everywhere.

units.source_text: 花容虽不见，自有暗香来。”

en.t: Though the flowers themselves cannot be seen, their hidden fragrance comes drifting of its own accord.
This appears in the Kokin Wakashu.

units.source_text: 薰君身上有异香，故引此歌。

en.t: Because Lord Kaoru has a strange fragrance about him, this poem is quoted here.
